scope: source rubric bundling and offline operation
regression fixtures, behavioural cases and CI

baseline.note: The first invalid-UTF-8 test was discovered to pass for the wrong reason and was strengthened. Findings include reproduced defects and explicitly labelled preventative review findings; no production impact is claimed.

findings.before: Approval could be borrowed from operating evidence or another decision.
findings.resolution: Explicit documentary approval targets, exact versions, named approvers, known accountable owners and independent pending report approval.

findings.before: Evidence from another system or an unassessed component could establish system acceptance.
findings.resolution: System/component evidence scope and whole-system criterion coverage; unsupported sibling components remain Unknown.
findings.regression: a component-only Accepted finding cannot cover an unassessed sibling

findings.before: A D7 assertion could invent a Legacy origin and launder provisional dependency evidence.
findings.resolution: Only D1-D6 or dated external attestations originate Legacy; D7 needs an independent qualified path and retains originating provisional status.

findings.before: All-simple-path enumeration is exponential even on a small acyclic graph.
findings.resolution: Shortest complete witnesses per origin/system/policy basis, deterministic traversal and explicit witness/segment budgets. A 28-node complete DAG produces 28 witnesses instead of over 67 million routes to its final node.
findings.regression: dense acyclic graphs produce bounded witnesses

findings.before: Report/JSON agreement depended on prose instructions and a partial golden-table test.
findings.resolution: Authoritative generated block, input digest, calculation version and --check-report; stale, tampered, absent or duplicate blocks fail.

findings.before: Only rubric names and URLs were bundled; blocked network access prevented a full numerical assessment.
findings.resolution: All 72 original anchors, original descriptions, quantitative examples, complete dated source snapshots and updated definition are bundled, licensed and integrity-pinned across all targets and installed scaffolds. Network access is optional refresh only.

findings.before: Dependency uncertainty was hidden at D7 when the consumer already had another gap.
findings.resolution: Dependency gaps tracked independently and propagated to a fixed point, even for already-undetermined consumers.
findings.regression: a consumer with its own gap still exposes dependency uncertainty

findings.before: Evidence completeness incorrectly changed a known classification outcome.
findings.resolution: Independent outcome, local policy basis, evidence completeness, provisional status and management completeness.
findings.regression: evidence completeness is independent of a known outcome

findings.before: Risk acceptance review dates, explicit evidence expiry, urgent Legacy and numerical red risks could be missed in review recommendations.
findings.resolution: Review dates include these events while keeping risk prioritisation separate from classification.

findings.before: Proposal evidence could be presented as completion and action dependency cycles were accepted.
findings.resolution: Every completion reference must be applicable dated operation/document evidence; iterative topological validation rejects action cycles without rejecting legitimate system cycles.
findings.regression: proposal evidence cannot be presented as completed remediation

findings.before: Duplicate JSON members were silently overwritten and direct scoring API inputs were insufficiently validated.
findings.resolution: Bounded duplicate-aware JSON parser, UTF-8/Unicode/number validation and shared schema validation for direct scoring calls.
findings.regression: the public scoring API rejects duplicate

findings.before: File and imported-API complexity were unbounded; named pipes could block before regular-file checking.
findings.resolution: Byte/node/depth/text budgets, bounded non-blocking reads, regular-file checks, bounded diagnostics and no partial output on failure.

findings.before: Calendar formatting failed early years and tie ordering depended on host locale.
findings.resolution: Explicit Gregorian calendar arithmetic and code-point ordering; unsupported anniversary overflow fails explicitly.

findings.before: A populated generated tree could ship stale runtime assets, and fresh scaffolds omitted Document Control partials.
findings.resolution: Builds regenerate by default, refuse drift when regeneration is skipped, gate required files before scaffolding, and copy rendering partials for every CLI.

findings.before: The Paperclip tool handler threw on malformed input and interpreted JavaScript replacement tokens in user topics.
findings.resolution: Type/length guards, literal callback substitutions before user text, normalized installed paths and compiled-handler tests in CI.
findings.regression: user topics preserve JavaScript replacement tokens literally

findings.before: Missing actions/owners/funding/dates or a red numerical risk could appear as an adequate plan.
findings.resolution: Explicit management gaps and action-plan completeness, independent of classification and evidence completeness.
findings.regression: an incomplete management plan remains visible

findings.before: The handwritten schema validator lacked an independent conformance check.
findings.resolution: Standard Draft 2020-12 validator tests, structural mutation comparisons, emitted-result validation and fail-closed supported schema formats.

findings.before: An artifact filename or report Document Control could contradict identity, version or pending approval.
findings.resolution: Artifact identity checks and structured Document Control consistency checks in report verification.

findings.before: The dependency fixture copied an unsupported rationale into a separately supported Reporting finding; one UTF-8 test passed for an unrelated unknown field.
findings.resolution: Corrected the fixture, preserved the live run's discovered conflict, and replaced the weak test with malformed bytes in a schema-valid evidence string.
findings.regression: invalid UTF-8 is not silently repaired

findings.before: The command did not clearly distinguish untrusted document instructions from assessor evidence.
findings.resolution: Explicit trust boundary, no interpolation/execution of evidence strings, and paired should-serve/injected-source evaluations. The paired live injection evaluation has not been run.
findings.status: guard implemented; paired live injection evaluation pending

limits: The helper validates structure, traceability and arithmetic, not evidence truth, signatures or the authority of a purported approver.
A matching results block does not validate every free-text recommendation.
Local owner thresholds remain necessary; the public updated definition supplies no complete quantitative threshold catalogue.
Full Claude and Gemini runtime checks remain unavailable in this environment.
The live Codex multi-system run first timed out at 240 seconds, then completed after continuation and was independently checked with the current helper.
Paired source-injection cases were added but their full live model evaluation remains unrun.
disposition: All reproduced implementation defects addressed. Human evidence/approval authority and the explicitly listed live-model coverage limits remain outside deterministic verification.

followUpContext.firecrawl: Installed but not authenticated; no scrape result produced. Source accessed through web tooling.
